say:1:1030002401:0.text: Hey! Young man! Come here! Don't you see the flames?!
say:1:1030002401:0.male: Hey! Young man! Come here! Don't you see the flames?!
say:1:1030002401:0.female: Hey! Young lady! Come here! Don't you see the flames?!

say:2:1030002402:0.text: This garden is upwind. There's no smoke over here. It's safe. Just don't walk toward the fire!
say:2:1030002402:0.source_cn: 这院子在上风处，没有浓烟飘过来，还算安全，可千万别再往...
say:2:1030002402:0.male: This garden is upwind. There's no smoke over here. It's safe. Just don't walk toward the fire!
say:2:1030002402:0.female: This garden is upwind. There's no smoke over here. It's safe. Just don't walk toward the fire!

say:3:1030002403:0.text: Here, I cut up my old apron. Cover your nose and mouth. You'll feel better.
say:3:1030002403:0.source_cn: 拿着，我把旧围裙剪开了。捂紧鼻子，能让你舒服点。
say:3:1030002403:0.male: Here, I cut up my old apron. Cover your nose and mouth. You'll feel better.
say:3:1030002403:0.female: Here, I cut up my old apron. Cover your nose and mouth. You'll feel better.
